rows.line: 途中で余韻をぶち壊した。
rows.en1: Totally killed the vibe.
rows.en2: Ruined the whole moment.

rows.line: でまあその話戻るけど
rows.en1: Anyway, back to what I was saying.
rows.en2: So, going back to that,

rows.ja: 結局〜たかったんやろね
rows.line: やっぱ結局やりたかったんやろね。
rows.en1: Guess I wanted to do it after all.
rows.en2: Deep down I wanted to.

rows.line: 万引きするより下手したら怒られるかも
rows.en1: You'd probably get chewed out worse.
rows.en2: Could be even worse, honestly.

rows.line: 絶対エラーだけはしちゃダメという
rows.en1: Whatever you do, don't make an error.
rows.en2: The one thing you can't do is screw up.

rows.line: そういうの刷り込まれるよね。
rows.en1: That stuff gets drilled into you.
rows.en2: It sticks with you.

rows.line: ちょっと負けたら早く帰れるなとか思いながら
rows.en1: Thinking, hey, if we lose, I get to go home early.
rows.en2: Kind of hoping we'd lose so I could leave.

rows.line: 近所の家にソフトボールが落ちて、意味がねえじゃん。
rows.en1: What's even the point?
rows.en2: Then what's the net for?

rows.line: まぁセンスなかったね、ソフトボール。
rows.en1: I just didn't have it.
rows.en2: I was never any good.

rows.line: なんか見たらわかるもんね。
rows.en1: You can just tell.
rows.en2: It's obvious when you see it.

rows.line: 運動神経ないなと言われたことあるし
rows.en1: People have told me I'm not athletic.
rows.en2: I've been called uncoordinated.

rows.ja: 分かる人分かると思います
rows.line: 分かる人分かると思います。
rows.en1: If you know, you know.
rows.en2: Some of you will get this.

rows.line: これ気づけよ、もう。
rows.en1: Come on, notice it!
rows.en2: How do you not see that?

rows.line: ちょっと人のせいにしようとしてみたり
rows.en1: I tried to blame someone else.
rows.en2: I tried to pin it on somebody.

rows.line: いろいろ頑張ったけど結局ダメで
rows.en1: I tried everything, but no luck.
rows.en2: Didn't work out anyway.

rows.ja: できるイメージがない
rows.line: 確かにできるイメージがないです。
rows.en1: I just can't picture it.
rows.en2: I can't see you pulling that off.

rows.line: 俺ね、意外と得意かもしれない。
rows.en1: I might actually be good at it.
rows.en2: Turns out I might be decent.

rows.ja: 〜って言ったら大げさやけど
rows.line: 世界を回ったって言ったら大げさやけど
rows.en1: Calling it a world tour's a stretch, but
rows.en2: I wouldn't go as far as saying I traveled the world, but

rows.line: 時給750円とはいえ
rows.en1: Even at 750 an hour,
rows.en2: Sure, it was only 750 an hour, but

rows.line: 社会を経験しとけよみたいな。
rows.en1: Go see how the real world works.
rows.en2: Get a taste of the real world.

rows.line: 俺が手癖悪かったらどうするのだろうとか言って
rows.en1: What if I had sticky fingers?
rows.en2: What if I pocketed some?

rows.line: そういうことか、それで車詳しいのか。
rows.en1: Oh, that explains it.
rows.en2: Ah, so that's why.

rows.line: うちの高校の部活みたいになってたよね。
rows.en1: It was basically like a club.
rows.en2: It turned into a hangout.

rows.line: 相当ストイックやったよ、俺も。
rows.en1: I was pretty hardcore.
rows.en2: I was really disciplined back then.

rows.line: 今信じられないし危ないよね。
rows.en1: I can't believe it now.
rows.en2: Crazy to think about now.

rows.line: それで俺も自信つけて
rows.en1: That gave me some confidence.
rows.en2: I got a little cocky after that.

rows.line: いやもう何でもいけるぜ、どこでも行けるぜみたいに
rows.en1: I felt like I could do anything.
rows.en2: I was like, bring it on.

rows.line: 次の便で良くないみたいな。
rows.en1: Why not just take the next one?
rows.en2: Can't we just grab the next one?

rows.ja: 人生であんなにきついの初めて
rows.line: 俺人生であんなにきついの初めてやもん。
rows.en1: Worst I've ever felt in my life.
rows.en2: Never been that wrecked in my life.

rows.line: 食いまくって、案の定。
rows.en1: And sure enough,
rows.en2: And of course, what do you know.

rows.line: どっかで腹壊してもと思って食いまくって
rows.en1: I figured, whatever, if I get sick, I get sick.
rows.en2: I just said screw it.

rows.line: 薬さえあれば俺もあんな苦しむことなかった
rows.en1: If I'd just had meds, I would've been fine.
rows.en2: Should've brought medicine.

rows.line: 正露丸じゃ全然話にならんレベル
rows.en1: It wasn't even close.
rows.en2: Didn't even make a dent.

rows.line: コメントいただけると嬉しいです。
rows.en1: Drop a comment, I'd love that.
rows.en2: Let me know in the comments.
